title: Hypothetical Advice: Mit tennél a helyemben?

sections.title: Asking for and Giving Guidance
sections.content: You know *a helyedben* ('in your place') and advice with the conditional from B1 Unit 7, and *ha* + conditional from A2 Unit 28. To solicit advice in a dilemma: *Mit tennél a helyemben?* ('What would you do in my shoes?'). Giving advice: *A helyedben én... conditional* (*A helyedben én elfogadnám az ajánlatot*).

items.spanish: Ha a helyemben lennél, te melyik ajánlatot választanád?
items.english: If you were in my place, which offer would you choose?

items.spanish: A te helyedben nem haboznék egyetlen percig sem.
items.english: In your place I wouldn't hesitate for a single minute.
